book.name: Mbouŋ To Yes Israela
book.title: Mbouŋ To Yes Israela Buk Song—Psalms

content: Maaron igham Israela timbuzŋa tipul Isip

content.text: Muuŋ, Israela tipul Isip ve tila.
Yakop paaghu tooni tipul tamtamon tau aliŋazi ite na, ve tivot.
Indeeŋ tana, yes Yuda timin Yoova niia patabuyaaŋ to lepoogh.
Ve yes Israela, tileep ila i niima ve iŋgin zi.
Saawe tau Te Siŋsiŋai ighita Yoova tamtamon tooni tilam, i iroi ve ighau.
Ve yaa Yordan ighit zi, le ipamuule iloŋ ila ve ipot imin yaa naliu.
Ve loloz tauvene paam. Yogyoog itok le tiyatyaat imin mekmek.
Ve nugh mbua mbua tiyatyaat imin sipsip natŋa.
O te, saa gabua ivot payo, ta ughau?
Ve yaa Yordan, puughu mindai ta utoor ghom ve umuul uzala?
Ve yam loloz ve nugh mbua mbua, ayatyaat pasaa?
O taan, uyamaan ghom! Malau mako pale Yoova ilam.
Paita Maaron to Yakop ilam, ve itotoi tapiri payo.
I ta igham yaa ivot ila maet, ve izi ipot imin yaa naliu.
Onoon kat, i igham yaa ivot ila maet ariaaŋa, ve ireer izi.
